content.short: BTC Direct is a European crypto broker and onramp provider serving retail and business customers.
content.description: BTC Direct is a European broker that has sold crypto to retail buyers since 2013 and claims more than 1.5 million customers. It lists over 50 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRP, Solana and Cardano, purchased in euros through iDEAL, bank transfer, credit card, PayPal, Apple Pay, Sofort or Bancontact. The company is MiCAR certified, with a minimum purchase of 50 euros. Alongside individual accounts it offers business accounts and a private trading desk for orders above 50,000 euros.
